summary: Validated cPanel/Passenger WSGI entrypoint (passenger_wsgi.py) and full backend regression after adding a2wsgi==1.10.10. New test file /app/backend/tests/test_passenger_wsgi.py imports `application` from passenger_wsgi (a2wsgi.ASGIMiddleware wrapping server.app), then drives it via raw WSGI environ dicts (io.BytesIO body, custom start_response) for: (1) GET /api/ -> 200 {status:ok}; (2) two sequential POST /api/diagnostic -> both 200 with distinct ids (guards against motor 'attached to a different loop' — a2wsgi runs the ASGI app on a single persistent loop so the memoized AsyncIOMotorClient stays valid across requests); (3) GET /api/diagnostic/{id} -> 200; (4) POST /api/lead with privacy_accepted=true -> 200, email_sent=false, diagnostic_id echoed, PDF build path exercised end-to-end. Import-time safety re-asserted: after `import server`, server._mongo_db and server._mongo_client are None, and neither 'reportlab' nor 'resend' are in sys.modules. Full suite: 39/39 passed (35 existing regression + 4 new WSGI tests). Note: existing test files (test_pontiscore_api, test_rgpd, test_editorial_pt, test_pdf_smoke) hard-code a fallback BASE URL of https://sme-health-check.preview.emergentagent.com and read EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; when run without that env var they 404 against the wrong host. Ran with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env — all green.

minor.issue: test_pontiscore_api.py / test_rgpd.py / test_editorial_pt.py / test_pdf_smoke.py fall back to a stale hard-coded preview host (sme-health-check...) when EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is unset; they should read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env like backend_test.py does.

action_items: Optional: normalize BASE URL resolution in test_pontiscore_api.py/test_rgpd.py/test_editorial_pt.py/test_pdf_smoke.py to prefer REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (or read /app/frontend/.env) so `pytest tests/` works without an ad-hoc env var. Not blocking — tests pass when the env var is provided.
Optional (repeat from prior iterations): migrate @app.on_event('shutdown') to FastAPI lifespan handlers to silence DeprecationWarning.
critical_code_review_comments: passenger_wsgi.py is minimal and correct: sys.path insert, `from server import app as asgi_app`, `application = ASGIMiddleware(asgi_app)`. Comments clearly explain the cPanel 'Application startup file' + 'Entry point = application' config and diagnose the original 'cannot find module servidor' misconfiguration.

a2wsgi.ASGIMiddleware maintains a single event loop for the wrapped ASGI app, which is exactly what the lazy motor client in get_db() needs to avoid 'attached to a different loop'. Verified empirically with two sequential POST /api/diagnostic calls through the WSGI callable.

Import-time safety continues to hold: cold `import server` opens no DB socket and does not import reportlab/resend — critical for cPanel/Passenger boot on shared hosting where startup RecursionError / import cost matters.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral diagnostics + one TEST WSGI lead created during pytest; TEST_-prefixed data from other suites.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passenger/WSGI wrapper is verified. If the user still hits errors on cPanel, the remaining likely causes are cPanel-side config (Application startup file not set to passenger_wsgi.py, Entry point not set to `application`, wrong Application root, or missing env vars like MONGO_URL). We cannot reproduce cPanel in this environment. To run the full suite in one go: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'cannot find module servidor' was a cPanel misconfiguration: Passenger's Application startup file (or Entry point) was pointing at a non-existent module 'servidor'. Fix implemented by main agent: added /app/backend/passenger_wsgi.py exposing `application = ASGIMiddleware(server.app)` (module name is `server`, not `servidor`) plus a2wsgi==1.10.10 in requirements.txt. This testing iteration confirms the wrapper is a valid WSGI callable and handles GET, sequential POSTs (motor loop stable), and the lead+PDF path — all 200 — with no regression to the uvicorn-served preview.
